decision_boundary: This approves presenting one fresh, exact reactivation request to the user. It does not change any Gate, route, artifact, deployment, CTA, affiliate eligibility, or database state.

source.replacement_source_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with LF line endings, matching the Git repository blob and deployment source

edge_control.official_basis: Cloudflare documents that Cache-Control no-transform prevents supported body changes, including automatic Web Analytics beacon injection.

pre_execution_requirements: regenerate packet freshness validation, renderer, and rendered-artifact preflight for these exact bindings immediately before execution
confirm the scoped Gate is CLOSED and the current replacement source hash still matches
confirm the route response still has Cache-Control no-transform and no Cloudflare beacon before replacement
post_execution_requirements: read the edge response and require HTTP 200, Cache-Control no-transform, no Cloudflare beacon, exactly 100 articles, and no preparing state
require the edge response SHA-256 to equal the exact rendered artifact SHA-256

rollback.trigger: any pre-execution or post-execution requirement failure, including edge SHA mismatch
rollback.operation: atomically restore items/index.html with the recorded replacement source hash and return the scoped Gate to CLOSED

expiry_conditions: the prior approval is reused instead of a fresh explicit approval
any packet, artifact, count, route, replacement-source, renderer-version, header, or preflight binding differs
the source packet no longer passes freshness and exact-scope validation immediately before execution
the edge response permits transformation or contains a Cloudflare beacon
any CTA, affiliate value, identifier, product link, ordering claim, or unreviewed active markup is introduced
